headword: {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}
gloss: arrogant, behaving as if no one else exists

definitions.gloss: arrogant, behaving as if no one else exists
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing someone who acts selfishly and inconsiderately, as if they were completely alone and others don't matter.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った。
examples.english: He behaved arrogantly, as if no one else mattered.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な{態度|たいど}を{取|と}る{人|ひと}がいる。
examples.english: There are people who behave inconsiderately on trains.

examples.japanese: {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な{運転|うんてん}で{事故|じこ}を{起|お}こした。
examples.english: The reckless driving caused an accident.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご})

LITERAL MEANING: {傍|かたわ}ら (beside) + {若|ごと}し (as if) + {無人|むじん} (no people) = Acting as if there were no one beside you.

ORIGIN: From the Chinese historical text 《{史記|しき}》 (Records of the Grand Historian), describing the behavior of the assassin {荊軻|けいか} (Jing Ke).

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な＋noun (arrogant ~)
・{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}に＋verb (arrogantly)
・{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い (arrogant behavior)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な{態度|たいど} (arrogant attitude)
・{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な{行動|こうどう} (inconsiderate behavior)
・{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う (to behave arrogantly)

NUANCE: Strongly negative, implying selfishness and complete disregard for others.

RELATED TERMS:
・{横柄|おうへい} - arrogant, haughty
・{尊大|そんだい} - arrogant, self-important
・{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち} - shameless, brazen
